CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD
AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount
AS(
    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CRDACCT_NBR ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN, * FROM (
    SELECT
    BCC.CRDACCT_NBR
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CLOSE
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR
    ,BCC.BNK_CODE
    ,RIGHT(LEFT(BCC.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE,10),4) AS BranchId
    ,BCC.LAST6_CRDACCT_NBR
    ,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCC.INSERT_DTTM
    FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP_DELTA BCCD
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP BCC ON BCC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR = BCCD.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR AND BCC.ISLATEST = 1
    WHERE BCC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR IS NOT NULL

UNION

    SELECT
    BCC.CRDACCT_NBR
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CLOSE
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR
    ,BCC.BNK_CODE
    ,RIGHT(LEFT(BCC.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE,10),4) AS BranchId
    ,BCC.LAST6_CRDACCT_NBR
    ,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCC.INSERT_DTTM
    FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP_DELTA BCCD
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP BCC ON BCC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR = BCCD.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR AND BCC.ISLATEST = 1
    WHERE BCC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR IS NOT NULL

) A
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount WHERE RN = 1;
--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_SRC
AS(
    SELECT
    HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
        CRDACCT_NBR
        ,CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN
        ,CRDACCT_DTE_CLOSE
        ,CRDACCT_CUST_NBR
        ,BNK_CODE
        ,BranchId
        ,LAST6_CRDACCT_NBR
    )) HASHROW, CRDACCT_NBR, RECORD_STATUS
    FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_TGT
AS(
    SELECT
    HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
        CustomerAccountId
        ,CustomerAccountOpenedDate
        ,CustomerAccountClosedDate
        ,CustomerId
        ,FinancialInstitutionId
        ,BranchId
        ,Last6AccountNumber
    )) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId
    FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA
AS(
SELECT
    SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
    ,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.CRDACCT_NBR,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
    ,CASE
        WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_TGT TGT
ON SRC.CRDACCT_NBR = TGT.CustomerAccountId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT
SET
[CustomerAccountId] = SRC.CRDACCT_NBR
,[CustomerAccountName] = NULL
,[CustomerAccountOpenedDate] = convert(date,convert(varchar,SRC.CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN))
,[CustomerAccountClosedDate] = CASE WHEN SRC.CRDACCT_DTE_CLOSE = 0 THEN CONVERT(DATE,NULL) ELSE convert(date,convert(varchar,SRC.CRDACCT_DTE_CLOSE)) END
,[GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber] = NULL
,[CustomerId] = SRC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR
,[ResponsibilityCenterId] = NULL
,[SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId] = NULL
,[LedgerId] = NULL
,[LedgerAccountNumber] = NULL
,[IsoCurrencyCode] = NULL
,[CustomerAccountTypeId] = NULL
,[CustomerAccountApplicationNumber] = NULL
,[BranchId] = SRC.BranchId
,[CustomerAccountShortName] = NULL
,[Last6AccountNumber] = SRC.LAST6_CRDACCT_NBR
,[SourceSystemCode] = 'CCD'
,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.BNK_CODE
,[WorkFlowId] = 0
,[TaskRunId] = 0
,[InsertDttm] = SRC.INSERT_DTTM
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount SRC ON SRC.CRDACCT_NBR = TGT.CustomerAccountId;

--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccount
(
CustomerAccountId
,CustomerAccountName
,CustomerAccountOpenedDate
,CustomerAccountClosedDate
,GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber
,CustomerId
,ResponsibilityCenterId
,SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId
,LedgerId
,LedgerAccountNumber
,IsoCurrencyCode
,CustomerAccountTypeId
,CustomerAccountApplicationNumber
,BranchId
,CustomerAccountShortName
,Last6AccountNumber
,SourceSystemCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT
CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
,NULL AS CustomerAccountName
,convert(date,convert(varchar,CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN)) AS CustomerAccountOpenedDate
,CASE WHEN CRDACCT_DTE_CLOSE = 0 THEN CONVERT(DATE,NULL) ELSE convert(date,convert(varchar,CRDACCT_DTE_CLOSE)) END AS CustomerAccountClosedDate
,NULL AS GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber
,CRDACCT_CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
,NULL AS ResponsibilityCenterId
,NULL AS SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId
,NULL AS LedgerId
,NULL AS LedgerAccountNumber
,NULL AS IsoCurrencyCode
,NULL AS CustomerAccountTypeId
,NULL AS CustomerAccountApplicationNumber
,BranchId AS BranchId
,NULL AS CustomerAccountShortName
,LAST6_CRDACCT_NBR AS Last6AccountNumber
,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
,BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM

FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT' and CRDACCT_NBR IS NOT NULL

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA;



END
